summary: Checks whether a value is a slide.
description: An Apps Script service object has no constructor a script can test against, so the guard looks for the methods that define the type — `getObjectId`, `getPageElementById`. A stub that implements them passes, which is what makes code using this guard testable outside the runtime.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a slide; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
const slide = SlidesApp.getActivePresentation().getSlides()[0];

isSlide(slide); // => true
isSlide({}); // => false
isSlide(null); // => false
```
